title: Bounded-above flat complexes on a ringed site are K-flat
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. A cochain complex $P^\bullet$ of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] is bounded above if $P^i=0$ for all $i>b$ for some integer $b$. Every bounded-above complex whose terms are flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules] is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex].

source.place: Lemma 06YS, bounded-above flat complexes are K-flat

proof.text: Let $A^\bullet$ be an arbitrary acyclic complex. For each integer $m$ let $\tau_{\le m}A^\bullet$ be its canonical (good) truncation, with terms $A^i$ for $i<m$, $\Ker(d^m)$ in degree $m$ and $0$ above; it is bounded above, and since $H^i(\tau_{\le m}A^\bullet)=H^i(A^\bullet)=0$ for $i\le m$ and $H^i(\tau_{\le m}A^\bullet)=0$ for $i>m$, it is acyclic [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules]. (The brutal truncations $\sigma_{\le m}A^\bullet$ would not do: they are not acyclic in general.) The inclusions $\tau_{\le m}A^\bullet\to\tau_{\le m+1}A^\bullet$ form a filtered system whose termwise colimit is $A^\bullet$. By [lem-pc-module-filtered-colimits-tensor], termwise colimits commute with tensoring by $P^\bullet$ and with totalization, so $\operatorname{Tot}(A^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}P^\bullet)=\varinjlim_m\operatorname{Tot}(\tau_{\le m}A^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}P^\bullet)$ termwise [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]; and filtered colimits are exact, so they commute with cohomology sheaves and a filtered colimit of acyclic complexes is acyclic. Hence it is enough to prove that $\operatorname{Tot}(\tau_{\le m}A^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}P^\bullet)$ is acyclic for every $m$, that is, to treat bounded-above acyclic $A^\bullet$.

source.place: Lemma 06YS (lemma-bounded-flat-K-flat), reduction to bounded-above acyclic complexes via the good truncations $\tau_{\le m}$

proof.text: For bounded-above acyclic $A^\bullet$ (such as $\tau_{\le m}A^\bullet$ of Step 1) and bounded-above $P^\bullet$ with flat terms, [lem-pc-bounded-above-flat-tensor-acyclic] says that $\operatorname{Tot}(A^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}P^\bullet)$ is acyclic. By Step 1 this gives acyclicity of $\operatorname{Tot}(A^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}P^\bullet)$ for the original acyclic $A^\bullet$.

source.place: Lemma 06YS (lemma-bounded-flat-K-flat), bounded-above case by the spectral sequence

proof.text: Because $A^\bullet$ was arbitrary and Steps 1--2 show that $\operatorname{Tot}(A^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}P^\bullet)$ is acyclic for every acyclic $A^\bullet$, the defining condition in [def-pc-kflat-complex] holds. Thus $P^\bullet$ is K-flat.
